about.heading: Your Trusted B2B Partner in Commercial Vehicle Components
about.lead: Since 2001, Samer Automotive has been a leading manufacturer and exporter of high-precision spare parts for commercial vehicles, trucks, and trailers.
about.paragraph1: Acting as the global sales and distribution division of Acar Metal, we combine advanced manufacturing capabilities with seamless international trade. From engineering to post-sales support, we supply premium components to distributors across Europe and worldwide.
about.paragraph2: Our strategy is built on long-term partnerships rather than short-term gains. Every component strictly complies with global quality standards, verified by ISO 9001, TÜV, and ADR certifications.
